decision.useCase: C4.1: interrupt Eva while she is speaking and continue with a new question
decision.retained: Ordinary HA voice pipeline, current wake model, original device audio and controls, shared Eva core; no native-WebSocket firmware replay
decision.confirmedGap: Retained recovery source stops VA or announcement on wakeword and does not restart listening. Authenticated current device readback matches retained recovery build. Source provenance is retained configuration/build record, not device flash extraction.
decision.smallestSolution: Reuse the exact existing voice-pe-interruption.yaml overlay on the saved private ordinary device config
decision.physicalResult: pending owner observation; metadata proves upload/connection/event availability, not audible stop or successful new question

wakeModelAvailabilitySourceCheck.finding: Saved firmware starts microWakeWord when the native voice-assistant client connects. It toggles only the separate Stop model around announcements/timers, and does not disable the regular wake model during spoken playback. Ordinary API disconnect updates LEDs; VA-client disconnect separately stops VA. Metadata probes did not register a voice-assistant client.
wakeModelAvailabilitySourceCheck.limit: Source inspection only; echo, microphone sampling and detected physical Hey Eva are not measured
